manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0009; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Ava orders in a cafe and encounters a further offer from Ben. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: A03 contrasts drinks; A05 reuses requesting repetition amid cafe noise; A06 requests a different drink without a model.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The explanation explicitly allows a coffee/a tea meaning a serving, avoiding a false general rule.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: A03 contrasts drinks; A05 reuses requesting repetition amid cafe noise; A06 requests a different drink without a model. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: Ava orders in a cafe and encounters a further offer from Ben. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
